result.topic_en: Toward showing that the discriminant of the base field divides the discriminant of the extension field of degree n = νμ, Hilbert begins proving a lemma: every integer ω of the extension, multiplied by a suitable number prime to a given α, can be written as a combination τ_1ε_1+...+τ_με_μ with fixed integers ε_i of the extension and integers τ_i of the base field.

items.english: Every number ω of the extension field, multiplied by a suitable number c that is prime to an arbitrarily given number α, can be brought into the form ω = τ_1ε_1 + ... + τ_με_μ, where ε_1,...,ε_μ are certain fixed μ integers of the extension field and τ_1,...,τ_μ are integers of the base field.
